sentences.text:
This is the first application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of regular bail relating to FIR No.38/2023, registered at Police Station-Budhni,
District-Sehore (M.P.) for the offence under Sections 363, 366 and 376(2)(n) of Indian Penal Code &
5/6 of POCSO Act.
2. Learned counsel appearing for applicant submitted that prosecutrix is aged about 17 years.
It is submitted that applicant is innocent.

In these circumstances,
applicant may be released on bail.
3 . Learned Deputy Government Advocate appearing for the State opposed the application for grant of bail.
It is submitted that FSL is positive.

5. Prosecutrix is aged about 17 years and have sufficient maturity and understanding.
6. Considering aforesaid facts and circumstances, bail application filed by applicant is allowed.

It is directed that applicant be released on bail on furnishing personal bond of Rs.50,000/-(Rs. Fifty Thousand only) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial court for his appearance before the trial court on the dates to be fixed by the trial court.
